title: The old cloud path for app accounts is barely tested
what: Making a gym, joining one by code, leaving it and moving to another gym on the old account path are never run by any test; the safety test only lists them as allowed. No test ever makes a trainer account on this path, so every trainer journey is untested, and the guard against an older summary overwriting a newer one is never tried.
expected: Database tests that make a gym and see a 6-letter code and the caller as owner, join by code and by a wrong code, leave as owner and trainer, move to another gym, and try an older summary.
who: members and owners on the old app account path
fix_line: Add a database test for the old account path: make, join, leave, move and a trainer

title: Starting a demo gym is tested only for the happy path
what: The only server test starts one demo and checks the key opens it and some products exist. Nothing tries the busy limit, an empty name, a second demo from the same person, a friend joining the demo, or that only a scrambled copy of the owner key is kept.
expected: Tests for the busy refusal and its words, the default name, a second separate demo, a friend joining, and the key never stored as typed.
fix_line: Add demo start cases to the shop orders database test

title: The gym's list of app members with orders and money spent is never tested on the server
what: No database test calls the list of members who joined in the app with their order counts and money spent, so it is unproven that it shows only this gym, counts a collected order once, or that orders of a deleted gym go within 30 days.
expected: A database test reading that list for two gyms, checking counts and money after a collect, and the clean-up of a gone gym's orders.
fix_line: Add the app members list to the access matrix and the shop orders test

title: Putting a demo gym online is tested once on the server
what: The server test puts a demo gym online one time. Nobody tries doing it twice with the same mobile, with a mobile already on the desk list, with a bad mobile, or checks that the old key stops working while the new sign-in keeps going. Those checks exist only against a pretend server in the browser test.
expected: Server tests for the repeat, the already-on-the-list refusal, the bad-number refusal, and the old key retired with the session still live.
fix_line: Add the go-online refusals to the shop orders database test

title: A support sign-in code leaves no record and its limits are never tested
what: Support can make a sign-in code that opens a whole gym, but the code maker writes nothing down about who made it or why, and no test checks it is six digits, refused for a desk person, or refused for a mobile that owns no gym.
expected: Every support code is written in the support log with who asked, and a test checks the refusals and the record.
how_often: each time support makes a code
fix_line: Write a log line when support makes a code and test it

title: The server limits on product price and stock are never tested
what: Only the panel's own form check refuses a price under 1 rupee or stock out of range. No database test sends such a product straight to the server, so nothing proves the server refuses it too, or keeps the total stock equal to the choices.
expected: A database test that saves a product under 1 rupee, below 0 or over 100000 stock, and with choices, and checks the refusals and the totals.
fix_line: Add product limit cases to the staff and owner rules database test

title: Typing a gym code by hand, a wrong code, or your own gym's code is never tested
what: Tests cover the invite link and switching with an open order, but none types another gym's code by hand and checks the gym is named before joining, none types a wrong code and checks the member stays in their own gym, and none scans the member's own gym and checks no second join happens.
expected: Phone tests for a hand-typed code, a wrong code keeping the member in place, and their own gym offering no switch.
fix_line: Add hand-typed, wrong and own-gym code cases to the phone shop tests
